gotchas: PRNG seeds must be strings like '12,345,6789,10' (arrays are rejected by the types). seedFromString() in src/lib/util/seed.ts derives one from any string; Daily passes seedFromString(info.battleSeed) because the session casts config.seed straight to PRNGSeed.

@pkmn/randoms randomSet() THROWS for species without a set in that gen's randomSets table — check generator.randomSets[speciesId] first. generateTeam calls are serialized through a promise-chain mutex because the generators share one PRNG.
The sim does NOT auto-flush updates: the session calls battle.sendUpdates() after setup and after every advance. Anyone driving a raw Battle must do the same.
Sim Pokémon have no `ident`; use pokemon.fullname. There is no Battle.forfeit(); forfeit uses battle.forceWin('p2') (logged as `>forcewin p2`, so a forfeited save restores as finished).

Never call pokemon.getStat('atk'|'spa'|'def'|'spd') outside a move from lib code — the sim fires Modify* events with a null move and ability handlers crash; use effectiveStat() from src/lib/ai/damage.ts.
The omniscient protocol log has |split|pX markers: keep the secret (exact-HP) line, drop the public twin (feeding both to the client tracker double-applies switches).
restoreBattleSession replays the input log and calls agent.choose() once per logged p2 choice to re-sync PRNG state, so OpponentAgent.choose must be deterministic and side-effect free.

src/lib/battle/legal.ts ignores maybeTrapped (Shadow Tag/Arena Trap); the engine can refuse a listed switch — the session returns ok:false and the UI re-prompts; the AI treats maybeTrapped as trapped.

NatDex ruleset includes 'Terastal Clause' (Tera disabled) and allows Megas/Z-moves. Trainer teams may use at most one Mega stone. Some trainer sets are ND-Uber by Smogon tiering (Mega Metagross, Mega Salamence, Dragapult, Espathra, Shed Tail) — the game never runs the tier validator.
Showdown avatar ids 'nemona' and 'arven' do not exist on the CDN; use 'nemona-masters' and 'arven-masters'. Backgrounds live at /sprites/gen6bgs/bg-<name>.jpg.

Next 16 dev: single-instance lock per checkout (a second `next dev` on another port is refused). In dev, the first hit on a dex-backed route (/pokedex, /trainers/[id]) can take 10–20 s while Turbopack compiles the @pkmn/dex chunk — production loads in ~1 s. `next dev` regenerates AGENTS.md in the repo root (git-ignored).
Do not place position:fixed overlays inside the <header> (backdrop-blur makes it their containing block); Modal and MobileDrawer are portaled to body.

BattleScreen persists the save (pc:battle:current) only after the first submitted choice; leaving at turn 1 leaves no save (Daily then offers 'Continue Daily Battle', which rebuilds the same deterministic setup).

The project folder name contains a space and capitals. .next/types/validator.ts can go stale when routes are deleted — rm -rf .next fixes typecheck. tsconfig includes scripts/**/*.mts in typecheck, so probe scripts must typecheck or be deleted.
Known cosmetic limit: on a 768px-tall window the full-width party menu extends below the fold (page scroll).
Running `next build` while `next dev` is serving the same checkout makes the dev client reconnect HMR in a loop and the page never hydrates — don't run both at once; reload after the build finishes.
Next 16 refuses a second `next dev` per checkout; port 3000 is often taken on this machine (the preview tool falls back to 3002).
Browser-tool clicks by ref scroll the element into view, which looks like the app scrolling; use coordinate clicks when checking scroll behaviour.
The battle-screen screenshots lag one state behind while the pane is throttled; prefer get_page_text for state checks.
